# Cube Cad Center

> Cube Cad Center is Ahmedabad's premier authorized CAD, BIM, and engineering design training institute, offering industry-aligned professional certifications across Architectural, Civil, Mechanical, and HVAC/MEPF disciplines with 100% placement assistance.

## Organization & Credentials

- **Institute Name**: Cube Cad Center
- **Locations**: Ahmedabad, Gujarat, India
  - **Satellite Campus**: 310, Iscon Emporio, Beside Star Bazaar, Near Jodhpur Cross Road, Satellite, Ahmedabad, Gujarat 380015
  - **South Bopal Campus**: C449, 4th Floor, SoBo Center, South Bopal, Above Gwalia, Ahmedabad, Gujarat 380058
- **Contact Numbers**: +91 9978999694, +91 9909996285, +91 9909997285
- **Official Email**: info@cubecadcenter.co
- **Key Statistics & Achievements**:
  - **5000+ Students Trained**: Empowered architects, civil engineers, mechanical engineers, and interior designers.
  - **17+ Industry Courses**: Comprehensive curriculum tailored to contemporary corporate engineering requirements.
  - **10+ Years Experience**: A decade of leadership in technical software training in Gujarat.
  - **90%+ Practical Training**: Hands-on approach centered on live construction drawings, 3D modeling, and real-world projects.
  - **100% Placement Assistance**: Dedicated placement cell connecting students with architectural firms, MNCs, and EPC contractors.
  - **Portfolio Outcomes**: Every graduate completes an industry-ready portfolio demonstrating real-world project capability.

## Core Disciplines & Courses

### Architectural & Interior Design
- **AutoCAD (2D & 3D Drafting)**: Architectural floor plans, elevations, sections, municipal submission drawings, working details, layer management, and plotting standards.
- **Revit Architecture (BIM)**: Building Information Modeling fundamentals, parametric family creation, construction documentation, sheet layouts, material schedules, and BOQ estimation.
- **SketchUp & Interior Design**: Fast conceptual 3D massing, interior spatial layout, textures, materials, lighting fixtures, realistic visualization, and client walkthroughs.
- **3ds Max & V-Ray**: High-end photorealistic architectural renders, advanced materials, camera framing, lighting setups, and interior/exterior visualization.

### Structural & Civil Engineering
- **STAAD.Pro & ETABS**: Multi-story structural analysis, RCC and steel frame design, wind and seismic loading (IS 1893, IS 456), foundation and slab detailing.
- **Revit Structure**: Structural BIM modeling, parametric column and beam framing, rebar detailing, and structural documentation.
- **AutoCAD Civil**: Site layout planning, contour mapping, cut-fill calculations, and civil infrastructure drafting.

### Mechanical & Product Design
- **SolidWorks**: 3D parametric feature-based modeling, advanced part and assembly design, sheet metal design, weldments, and standard manufacturing drawings.
- **CATIA**: Generative surface design, automotive body modeling, aerospace components, and assembly kinematics.
- **Creo Parametric**: High-precision mechanical design, manufacturing tooling, sheet metal fabrication, and assembly constraints.
- **AutoCAD Mechanical**: Production drafting, tolerance analysis, GD&T standards, bill of materials (BOM), and mechanical part libraries.

### HVAC & MEPF Engineering
- **HVAC Engineering**: Heat load calculations (E20 and HAP methods), duct design, chiller and AHU layout, duct routing, and equipment selection.
- **Revit MEP (BIM)**: 3D mechanical ducting, electrical cable tray layouts, plumbing pipe systems, and automated clash detection.
- **Plumbing & Fire Protection (MEPF)**: Water supply distribution, drainage systems, sprinkler layout, fire hydrant design, and NFPA-compliant schematics.

## Program Offerings & Flexibility
- **Training Formats**: Classroom onsite training and hybrid blended learning.
- **Schedules**: Regular weekday morning/evening batches and specialized weekend batches for working professionals.
- **Software Licenses**: Practice licenses provided to students on personal workstations.
